insights.question: What pick/ban tendencies repeat most?
insights.title: Poppy is always on their mind
insights.text: They pick or ban Poppy in 37/69 games (54%): 4 picks (4-0) and 33 bans.

insights.question: What pick/ban tendencies repeat most?
insights.title: Teams respect-ban Yone against them
insights.text: Opponents banned Yone against them in 40/69 games (58%).

insights.question: What pick/ban tendencies repeat most?
insights.title: They open bans on Rumble
insights.text: Rumble is their first ban in 20/69 games (29%). Expect it gone before your first pick.

insights.question: How does the draft shift in Fearless G2/G3+?
insights.title: No Rakan? They go Bard
insights.text: Rakan is a G1 favorite (6/29 G1s, played by Eyla). In the 20 later games where it was burned or banned, Eyla went to Bard (4/20) and Alistar (3/20).

insights.question: How does the draft shift in Fearless G2/G3+?
insights.title: In G3+ they stay closer to their core than most
insights.text: In 19 G3+ games, 23/95 picks (24%) were champions they never played in any G1 (league 31%). Pool: 55 champs in G1s, 55 in G3+.
